question.problem:
The vectors ${a}_{1},$ ${a}_{2},$ ${a}_{3},$ and ${a}_{4}$ are given below. Determine whether $B=\{{a}_{1},{a}_{2},{a}_{3}\}$ is a basis of $\text{Span}\{{a}_{1},{a}_{2},{a}_{3},{a}_{4}\}.$ If that is the case, find ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3},$ where ${a}_{4}={x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}.$

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 3 \\ 7\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 3 \\ 8\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{4}=[\begin{aligned}-7 \\ -21 \\ -52\end{aligned}]
$$
question.worked_solution:
We want to determine if $B$ is indeed a basis of $\text{Span}\{{a}_{1},{a}_{2},{a}_{3},{a}_{4}\}.$ So, we want to find ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},{x}_{3}\in R$ such that 

$$
{x}_{1}{{[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 3 \\ 7\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{a}_{1}}+{x}_{2}{{[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{a}_{2}}+{x}_{3}{{[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 3 \\ 8\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{a}_{3}}={{[\begin{aligned}-7 \\ -21 \\ -52\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{a}_{4}}.
$$

This equation is equivalent to the system

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+{x}_{3}=-7 \\ 3{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+3{x}_{3}=-21 \\ 7{x}_{1}+8{x}_{3}=-52\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we reduce the augmented matrix of the system to reduced row echelon form (RREF):

$$
\begin{aligned} & \,\,[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 1 & -7 \\ 3 & 1 & 3 & -21 \\ 7 & 0 & 8 & -52\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-3){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 1 & -7 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 7 & 0 & 8 & -52\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-7){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 1 & -7 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -3\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :={R}_{1}+(-1){R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & -4 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -3\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

From the reduced matrix above, we see that the pivot columns are the $1$st, $2$nd, and $3$rd columns. So,  $B$ is indeed a basis of $\text{Span}\{{a}_{1},{a}_{2},{a}_{3},{a}_{4}\}.$
Also, the matrix tells us that ${x}_{1}=-4,$ ${x}_{2}=0,$ and ${x}_{3}=-3,$ meaning that

$$
(-4)\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 3 \\ 7\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{a}_{1}}+0\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{a}_{2}}+(-3)\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 3 \\ 8\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{a}_{3}}={{[\begin{aligned}-7 \\ -21 \\ -52\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{a}_{4}}.
$$

Therefore, ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=(-4)+0+(-3)=-7.$
